npcs.name: Waiting Visitor
npcs.description: A visitor stands near the entrance, smoothing the edge of a document folder and occasionally checking the doors.

npcs.name: Arriving Employee
npcs.description: An employee slows near the entrance to tuck a loose sleeve under the strap of a shoulder bag.

npcs.name: Waiting Courier
npcs.description: A courier balances a small parcel against one hip, shifting their weight while they wait.

npcs.name: Returning Resident
npcs.description: A resident pauses with a shopping bag in each hand, readjusting the handles before continuing.

npcs.name: Lobby Receptionist
npcs.description: The receptionist sits behind the desk, straightening a small stack of blank forms between glances toward the entrance.

npcs.name: Lunch Break Employee
npcs.description: An employee sits with an open lunch container, carefully separating the pieces with a fork.

npcs.name: Passing Employee
npcs.description: An employee carries a mug through the hallway, keeping it level with both hands.
